name: Rashid Ahmad Gangohi
role: Deobandi scholar of fiqh and tasawwuf
contribution: Rashid Ahmad Gangohi was a Deobandi scholar known for work in Islamic law, spirituality, and religious guidance.
context: His authority developed through post-1857 networks of madrasas, legal opinions, and teacher-student lineages across North India.
impact: Those networks influenced ulama and madrasa traditions in Bengal and helped shape modern South Asian Sunni reform.
highlight: A major Deobandi authority behind later Bengal-connected ulama networks.
seoTitle: Rashid Ahmad Gangohi: Deobandi Scholar of Fiqh and Tasawwuf
seoDescription: Explore Rashid Ahmad Gangohi’s role in Deobandi scholarship, fiqh, tasawwuf, and the teacher-student networks that reached Bengal.
shortAnswer: Rashid Ahmad Gangohi was a major Deobandi scholar whose work in Islamic law and spirituality influenced South Asian ulama networks.
